name: digital-twin-from-observations
description: Build a digital twin of a physical system entirely from observed input-output data, without access to internal design or source code. Covers boundary definition through deployment and drift monitoring.

config.instruction: Define the system boundary: every input, output, and environmental signal. Assess which internal states are observable from boundary signals.
Segment data by operating domain. Identify a model per domain using system identification. Determine switching conditions between domains.
Validate the twin against held-out data. Iterate on model structure for domains where error exceeds measurement uncertainty.
Package the twin with interface spec and accuracy contract. Set up drift detection and re-identification triggers.
